thesis: Mox Jet turns black's most punishing one-mana effects into turn-zero or turn-one plays, amplifying discard, tutors, graveyard engines, and combo rituals.

competitiveTimeline.significance: The archive connects early powered control to Gro-A-Tog, prison, combo, and Old School black strategies, illustrating how one black mana can support very different plans.

playbook.role: Sequence Jet around the spell that most benefits from being early: discard before the opponent develops, a tutor with mana left to act, or a black permanent that anchors the game. Do not expose it casually to artifact shutdown if a land can perform the same immediate job.

counterplay.directAnswers: Attack the artifact-mana network with Null Rod effects or punish the low permanent count after the initial burst. Once Jet has enabled a first-turn tutor or discard sequence, counterplay must focus on the resulting engine rather than the spent acceleration.
